_comment: Who the coach is coaching. Every value here is an example. Nothing in this file is real, and nothing about a real person belongs in a committed config file: height, date of birth and sex are read from env vars at runtime (VITE_HEIGHT_CM, VITE_BIRTHDATE, VITE_SEX) and the values below are only the fallbacks the demo uses.
dietaryPattern: pescatarian (fish and eggs and dairy, no meat)
_dietaryPatternComment: Free text. Nutri reads it and names foods accordingly. The shipped recipes in knowledge/recipes are pescatarian; swap them if your pattern differs.
